source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs in sub-Saharan Africa, endorsed by the World Health Organization in 2007, have scaled up to circumcise millions of men, with three randomized controlled trials in Uganda, Kenya, and South Africa demonstrating a 51–60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition risk for circumcised men compared to uncircumcised controls over 24–30 months of follow-up. [47] [48]
